description: This Java source file defines the final class AclEnforcerCacheLoader, which implements AsyncCacheLoader to asynchronously load Access Control List (ACL) enforcers by querying a shard-region-proxy actor. It constructs cache entries based on responses from remote fetches, facilitating cache operations related to access control enforcement in a distributed system.

classes.name: AclEnforcerCacheLoader
classes.description: Implements an asynchronous cache loader that retrieves ACL enforcers by querying a remote actor proxy. It handles responses specific to ACL retrieval operations and constructs cache entries accordingly.

methods.name: asyncLoad
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous load of cache entries for a given key using the delegate cache loader.

methods.name: handleSudoRetrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Processes responses from remote fetch operations, extracting ACL enforcers from 'SudoRetrieveThingResponse' objects or handling exceptions indicating inaccessibility.

methods.name: badThingResponse
methods.description: Creates a Supplier that, when invoked, produces an IllegalStateException indicating a bad or unexpected response.
